mapper.select: select HISTORY_ID, T.PRODUCT_ID, TRADE_TYPE, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, FINAL_PRICE, to_char(COMPLETED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "CREATED_AT_STR" from TRANSACTION_HISTORY T left join USERS UB on T.BUYER_NO = UB.USER_NO left join USERS US on T.SELLER_NO = US.USER_NO left join PRODUCTS P on T.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID where UB.USER_NO = #{userNo} or US.USER_NO = #{userNo} order by T.COMPLETED_AT desc
